blocks.text: Describes the two modules inside the package (client.py for DeviceLink and reconnect.py for backoff/error classes), lists the typical usage pattern as a code block, and states the websockets-isolation rule.
blocks.title: Package docstring

blocks.text: Two import blocks pull every public name from the internal modules. .client contributes DeviceLink, LinkCallbacks, the event/stats/run dataclasses, and the protocol-level constants. .reconnect contributes the full error hierarchy (10 error classes), Backoff, BackoffPolicy, classify, and retry_after_of.
blocks.title: Re-exports from client and reconnect

blocks.text: Lists every re-exported name in alphabetical order. Its length matches the union of the two import blocks, so there are no hidden or accidentally-omitted exports.
blocks.title: __all__ declaration

gotchas: websockets is imported only inside this package — no other m2c module may import it (tests/test_cli.py enforces this)
Tool execution is NOT here: tool_proposed events are stored and surfaced via LinkCallbacks, but C05 and later patches handle actually running tools
how_it_works: Imports the public symbols from .client (DeviceLink, LinkCallbacks, LinkEvent, LinkStats, RunInfo, ServerError, Welcome, SOCKET_PATH, SUPPORTED_PROTOCOLS, device_socket_url, recover_last_seq)
Imports the error hierarchy and reconnect helpers from .reconnect (Backoff, BackoffPolicy, classify, retry_after_of, and all LinkError subclasses)
Declares __all__ to match those imports exactly, so 'from m2c.link import *' is well-defined
purpose: Acts as the single import point for everything a caller needs to open a WebSocket connection to the MiniMe server. It draws together DeviceLink, LinkCallbacks, the full error hierarchy, and the reconnect/backoff primitives so callers never have to import from the two internal modules directly.
summary: Public surface of the m2c.link package: re-exports DeviceLink, error classes, reconnect helpers, and protocol constants from client.py and reconnect.py.
unknowns: Which external callers (CLI, TUI, tests) import from m2c.link is not visible in this file
